title: Practice 1: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The machine needs oiling.
exercises.why: **нуждаться → нуждается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Том всегда ___ (держать) в багажнике своей машины комплект кабелей для «прикуривания».
exercises.prompt: Tom always keeps a set of jumper cables in the trunk of his car.
exercises.why: **держать → держит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Одноклеточный организм ___ (состоять) только из одной клетки.
exercises.prompt: A single-celled organism consists of just one cell.
exercises.why: **состоять → состоит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Он ___ (делать) вид, что преисполнен энтузиазма, когда начальник где-то рядом.
exercises.prompt: He pretends to be enthusiastic when his boss is around.
exercises.why: **делать → делает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He knows how to pluck a chicken.
exercises.why: **уметь → умеет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm hating this weather!
exercises.why: **ненавидеть → Ненавижу** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Pablo, the table isn't for sitting!
exercises.why: **сидеть → сидят** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Do you like carbonated water?
exercises.why: **любить → любишь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Дом, где родился Ататюрк, ___ (находиться) в Салониках.
exercises.prompt: The home where Atatürk was born is in Thessaloniki.
exercises.why: **находиться → находится** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: После ванны я ___ (чувствовать) себя весьма посвежевшим.
exercises.prompt: I feel quite refreshed after taking a bath.
exercises.why: **чувствовать → чувствую** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: He buries his treasure.
exercises.why: **закапывать → закапывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It smells of salt and algae.
exercises.why: **пахнуть → Пахнет** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Парадокс спорта в том, что он как ___ (сплачивать), так и разделяет.
exercises.prompt: The paradox of sport is that it bonds as it divides.
exercises.why: **сплачивать → сплачивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Иногда в блевотине моей кошки я ___ (замечать) травинки.
exercises.prompt: Sometimes I see blades of grass in my cat's vomit.
exercises.why: **замечать → замечаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Oil does not mix with water.
exercises.why: **смешиваться → смешивается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Мэри заметила, как Том с Кончитой ___ (флиртовать).
exercises.prompt: Mary spotted Tom and Conchita flirting together.
exercises.why: **флиртовать → флиртуют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Euclid's main work is called Elements.
exercises.why: **называться → называется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I dedicate this song to you.
exercises.why: **посвящать → посвящаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: I don't care for sports.
exercises.why: **волновать → волнует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Buddhist monks shave their heads.
exercises.why: **брить → бреют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
